summary: PDS Biotechnology filed an 8-K disclosing the simultaneous resignation, effective October 18, 2026, of four directors — Kamil Ali-Jackson, Stephen Glover, Gregory Freitag and Otis Brawley — each citing no disagreement with the Company on operations, policies or practices. The Board then appointed Deborah Ramsdell (Class A, term to 2027 annual meeting), John Dawson (Class B, to 2029) and Bruce Wendel (Class C, to 2028) to fill three of four vacancies, and fixed the board at seven members. No compensation, advisor or consideration terms were disclosed; one vacancy remains unfilled, a governance detail to watch.
